name: Beginner
tagline: Clean messy data, build a star schema, write the core measures and ship one trustworthy page.
seo: Beginner Power BI practice: clean data in Power Query, build a star schema, write core DAX measures and publish a report. Every assignment has a checkable result and a worked solution.
intro: Everything here is done in Power BI Desktop with the mouse. If you can finish all five topics you are employable as a junior. Do not skip the date-table assignment: every later level assumes you did it.
